name: Naala
source:
Although she is treated like the stepsister of Oori, the king of Rusu, Naala doesn't have a "holier than thou" atmosphere that is typical of somebody in her position. Since her father passed away when she was 5, and her widowed mother was abducted by the forces of the northern kingdom of Nasura, Naala has been robbed of her blood relatives from a young age. She was meant to wed Oori without any issues, however, Naala gets attacked by the Nasura army...

[Based on the [URL=http://ignote.net/operetta2/benibana/benibana2/character.html#TabPanel01]official website profile[/URL].]
